function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

function.name: write_markdown_tool
function.description: Writes the provided content to a Markdown (.md) file on the disk. This function should be used when there is a need to persist text data in Markdown format as a result of a user action or a process that requires saving information in a structured text file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool
function.description: Writes an HTML file to disk with the given content. Ensures HTML tags within the content are properly closed. This function should be used when there is a need to save HTML content to a file as part of a 'save' operation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re looking for a simple web interface, a mobile app, or an API for integration into your own system.

| Category | Tool / Platform | What it offers | Typical use case |
|----------|-----------------|----------------|------------------|
| **Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)** | **Expedia** | Aggregates flights, hotels, car rentals, packages. | One‑stop booking for leisure or business trips. |
| | **Kayak** | Flight comparison, price alerts, flexible date search. | Finding the cheapest or best‑timed flight. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global flight search, multi‑city itineraries, price alerts. | Budget travelers, multi‑stop trips. |
| | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price graph, “Explore” map. | Quick price comparison, exploring destinations. |
| | **Momondo** | Price comparison, “Best deals” filter. | Finding hidden bargains. |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” and Express Deals. | Last‑minute or discounted seats. |
| | **Orbitz** | Loyalty program, bundle discounts. | Frequent travelers who want points. |
| | **Travelocity** | Similar to Orbitz, often bundled with hotels. | All‑in‑one booking. |
| | **Hotwire** | Discounted “opaque” fares, last‑minute deals. | Budget travelers willing to accept unknown details until booking. |
| | **CheapOair** | Discounted fares, promo codes. | Price‑sensitive travelers. |
| | **Booking.com** (flight section) | Mainly hotels, but offers flight search. | Travelers who already use Booking.com for accommodations. |
| | **Trip.com** (formerly Ctrip) | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency support. | International travelers, especially in Asia. |
| | **Opodo** | European OTA, flight + hotel bundles. | European travelers. |
| | **Traveloka** | Southeast Asian OTA, flight + hotel + local experiences. | Southeast Asian travelers. |
| | **MakeMyTrip** | Indian OTA, flight + hotel + holiday packages. | Indian travelers. |
| | **Agoda** | Primarily hotels, but offers flight search. | Travelers who use Agoda for stays. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Price alerts, coupon codes. | Price‑watching enthusiasts. |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, mobile app. | Mobile‑first travelers who want to know when to book. |
| | **Rome2rio** | Multi‑modal travel planner (flight + train + bus). | Complex itineraries. |
| | **TripIt** | Trip organizer, not a booking tool but syncs bookings. | Post‑booking itinerary management. |
| | **Google Trips** (now integrated into Google Travel) | Trip planning, itinerary sync. | Organizing travel plans. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not flights, but can book local experiences. | Complementary travel planning. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking, not booking. | Tracking flights. |
| | **FlightAware** | Flight status, not booking. | Monitoring flight status. |
| | **FlightStats** | Flight status, not booking. | Monitoring flight status. |
| | **FlightNetwork** | Aggregated flight search. | General flight search. |
| | **CheapTickets** | Discounted fares, promo codes. | Budget travelers. |
| | **JetRadar** | Flight search, price alerts. | Price monitoring. |
| | **FlightHub** | Discounted fares, last‑minute deals. | Budget travelers. |
| | **Travelzoo** | Deals & coupons, not direct booking. | Finding deals. |
| | **Travelpayouts** | Affiliate flight booking API. | Developers building travel sites. |
| | **Skiplagged** | Hidden city ticketing. | Savvy travelers looking for cheaper routes. |
| | **OpenSky** | Flight data API, not booking. | Developers needing flight data. |
| | **Amadeus API** | Full flight booking API, inventory, pricing. | Enterprise travel tech. |
| | **Sabre API** | Global distribution system (GDS) API. | Travel agencies, airlines. |
| | **Travelport API** | GDS API for flight, hotel, car. | Travel agencies. |
| | **Expedia Rapid API** | Flight booking, inventory. | Travel agencies, developers. |
| | **Priceline Partner Network API** | Flight booking. | Travel agencies. |
| | **Kayak API** | Flight search, price alerts. | Developers. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Flight search, price alerts. | Developers. |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | Flight search. | Developers. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, not booking. | Developers. |
| | **OpenFlights API** | Flight data, not booking. | Developers. |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, not booking. | Developers. |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Flight tracking, not booking. | Developers. |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight booking. | Affiliate marketers. |
